description.en: The ID of the host group.

description.zh: 专有宿主机组的名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、英文句号（.）、下划线（_）或连字符（-）。不能包含`http://`和`https://`。
description.en: The name of the host group. It must be 2 to 128 characters in length and start with a letter. It can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-), and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 专有宿主机组的描述。长度为2~256个字符。不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
description.en: The description of the host group. It must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 专有宿主机组所在的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the host group. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 修改专有宿主机组的信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs modify-dedicated-host-cluster-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-cluster-id dc-bp12wlf6am0vz9v20000 --dedicated-host-cluster-name newClusterName --description newClusterDescription --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs ModifyDedicatedHostClusterAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --Description newClusterDescription --DedicatedHostClusterName newClusterName --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DedicatedHostClusterId 'dc-bp12wlf6am0vz9v20000'
